integrity: Proved via endpoint Rayleigh bound, all-n Laplacian shape lemma, lazy decomposition and explicit optimizer. Exact-rational and numerical checker corroborates; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform finite lattice target; symmetric state-independent integer proposals with rejection. The shape-stability coefficient is not claimed sharp; continuous positions, state-dependent proposals and arbitrary reversible kernels are outside scope. Additional unindexed prior mathematical coverage remains possible.
title: Unique fastest symmetric rejected-jump sampler on every finite interval
